head.description: Conflei Food Truck, Miami FL: family-run Venezuelan street food truck at 8280 NW 66th St. Maracaibo-style hamburguesas, patacones and tequeños. 5.0 rating from 202 Google reviews. Call (321) 424-2262.

jsonld.name: Conflei Food Truck
jsonld.description: Family-run Venezuelan street food truck parked at 8280 NW 66th St, Miami, FL. Known for Maracaibo-style hamburguesas, patacones, tequeños and arepas.

eyebrow.es: Miami, FL · Comida venezolana sobre ruedas

parrafo.es: Conflei Food Truck estaciona en el 8280 NW 66th St de Miami con hamburguesas estilo Maracaibo, patacones, tequeños y arepas hechas al momento. Las reseñas de Google repiten lo mismo: una familia que te recibe como en casa.
parrafo.en: Conflei Food Truck parks at 8280 NW 66th St in Miami with Maracaibo-style hamburguesas, patacones, tequeños and arepas cooked to order. Google reviewers keep saying the same thing: a family that makes you feel at home.

hero.imagen_alt: Loaded Conflei Food Truck hamburguesa stacked with cheese, bacon and fresh lettuce

parrafo_1.es: Conflei Food Truck es una cocina venezolana familiar sobre ruedas, estacionada en el 8280 NW 66th St de Miami. Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: el dueño y su familia atienden cada mesa en persona, y se nota en cómo funciona el negocio.
parrafo_1.en: Conflei Food Truck is a family-run Venezuelan kitchen on wheels, parked at 8280 NW 66th St in Miami. Reviewers keep pointing to the same thing: the owner and family greet every table themselves, and it shows in how the place runs.

parrafo_2.es: El propio rótulo de la camioneta dice "Siente el sabor sobre ruedas", y con 5.0 de calificación en 202 reseñas de Google y más de 10,000 seguidores en Instagram (@conflei_usa), no es solo un eslogan.
parrafo_2.en: The truck's own sign reads "Siente el sabor sobre ruedas" (feel the flavor on wheels), and with a 5.0 rating across 202 Google reviews and over 10,000 followers on Instagram (@conflei_usa), that is not just a slogan.

texto.es: Conflei estaciona en el 8280 NW 66th St de Miami. Llama al (321) 424-2262 si quieres confirmar que está abierto antes de ir.
texto.en: Conflei parks at 8280 NW 66th St in Miami. Call (321) 424-2262 if you want to confirm it is open before you drive over.

texto.es: Hamburguesas, patacones, tequeños, arepas, pepitos o nuggets: el menú está pintado en la propia camioneta, así que lo ves antes de pedir.
texto.en: Hamburguesas, patacones, tequeños, arepas, pepitos or nuggets: the menu is painted right on the truck, so you see it before you order.

texto.es: Todo sale caliente de la parrilla directo a tu bandeja, tal como lo describen las reseñas: rápido y fresco.
texto.en: Everything comes hot off the grill straight to your tray, just like reviewers describe it: fast and fresh.

texto.es: Toma asiento en las mesas plegables junto a la camioneta y disfruta. Las reseñas la describen como súper limpia y familiar.
texto.en: Grab a seat at the folding tables next to the truck and dig in. Reviewers call it super clean and family-friendly.

nota.es: Conflei no publica precios en línea. Llama al (321) 424-2262 o pasa por el 8280 NW 66th St y el menú pintado en la camioneta te dirá exactamente cuánto cuesta cada plato.
nota.en: Conflei does not post prices online. Call (321) 424-2262 or swing by 8280 NW 66th St and the menu painted on the truck will tell you exactly what each plate costs.

texto.es: Las reseñas las mencionan por nombre: una hamburguesa grande y cargada estilo Maracaibo, descrita como "muy grande y deliciosa".
texto.en: Reviewers single these out by name: a big, loaded burger built Maracaibo-style, called "very big and delicious".

texto.es: Mitades de plátano verde frito rellenas y apiladas, uno de los platos que se repite tanto en el arte del menú como en las reseñas.
texto.en: Fried green plantain halves stuffed and stacked, one of the dishes that keeps showing up both in the truck's own menu art and in reviews.

texto.es: Los clásicos palitos de queso venezolanos, mencionados junto a las hamburguesas como favoritos de los clientes.
texto.en: The classic Venezuelan cheese sticks, called out right alongside the hamburguesas as a customer favorite.

texto.es: Arepas, pepitos y nuggets completan el tablero para quien busca algo distinto a una hamburguesa.
texto.en: Arepas, pepitos and nuggets round out the board for anyone who wants something other than a burger.

pie.es: Abiertos lunes, martes y domingo de 6:30 a 11 PM, y viernes-sábado de 6:30 PM a 12 AM. Cerrados miércoles y jueves. Llama antes de ir.
pie.en: Open Monday, Tuesday and Sunday 6:30-11 PM, and Friday-Saturday 6:30 PM-12 AM. Closed Wednesday and Thursday. Call ahead before you drive over.

subtitulo.es: 202 reseñas verificadas en Google, todas en un 5.0 de calificación.
subtitulo.en: 202 reviews, all verified on Google, landing on a perfect 5.0 rating.

items.quote: Must eat!!! This food truck hit the spot on a Tuesday night when everything was closed. Family owned authentic Venezuelan food at an affordable price with the best top notch service. Super clean, can't wait to go back.
Customer service was very good. Good people. The hamburger is very big and delicious. As well as the tequeños. Food came out fast.
The best. You have no idea how difficult it is to find good Venezuelan food. Food is great and service excellent. 10/10

texto.es: Confirma que esté abierto antes de ir: solo trabajan lunes, martes, viernes, sábado y domingo por la noche.
texto.en: Check it is open before you drive over: it only runs Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday evenings.

texto.es: Más de 10,000 seguidores siguen los especiales y la ubicación de la camioneta día a día.
texto.en: Over 10,000 followers track the daily specials and the truck's location.

notas_variante_adaptada.sin_precios_publicados: No Google listing, aggregator (atly.com) or the truck's own signage publishes exact prices. Services section shows real dish names without precio + note telling people to call or read the menu board.
notas_variante_adaptada.resenas: 4 distinct verbatim 5-star Google reviews captured via scripts/_research_place.js (ran twice, consistent results): Sandra Cruz, Jessica Hayes, Luis Sosa, Andrea Brito. Used social_proof.modo:'testimonios' with the 3 most specific/distinct quotes (Jessica Hayes, Luis Sosa, Andrea Brito); Sandra Cruz's quote was closest in content to Jessica's and left out to avoid repetition.
notas_variante_adaptada.ig_descubierto_en_fotos: No Instagram/Facebook was findable via Maps listing or WebSearch alone. The real handle @conflei_usa was spotted painted on the truck itself in gmaps-1.jpg and gmaps-3.jpg (next to Instagram/Facebook/TikTok/Google icons) and independently confirmed live at instagram.com/conflei_usa (title 'Conflei Food Truck | Miami (@conflei_usa)', og:description '10K Followers, 4,128 Following, 1,854 Posts').
notas_variante_adaptada.sin_website_propio: No DNS for conflei.com / confleifoodtruck.com. WebSearch for the business name + website / menu / reviews returns only aggregator pages (atly.com) and the Google Maps listing, no dedicated site.
notas_variante_adaptada.fotos: Research script (_research_place.js) only surfaced 2 of the Google listing's photos directly; 6 more were recovered via atly.com's cached copies of the same Google Maps photo set (steps.me hotlink-protected thumbnails failed to download, so the Google-hosted originals were used instead). All 8 kept photos were visually reviewed one by one; a 9th (gmaps-9, a burger shot with a decorative Instagram-story snow filter overlay) was dropped as not clean enough for the gallery.
